name: format-on-edit
description: Formats every file the agent writes with the project's formatter (Prettier, Ruff, Black, gofmt, rustfmt) and tells the agent to re-read it.
inspiredBy: Claude Code PostToolUse formatting hooks (Prettier / Black on Edit|Write)

onlyConfigured.description: Only run a formatter the project configures (Prettier config, [tool.ruff] / [tool.black], rustfmt.toml...). gofmt always runs for Go.
